channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Christian Wood | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Christian Wood from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tom Dundon on Christian Wood
item.description:
Chris Mannix ON Tom Dundon:

“He has some wild ideas. Somebody told me recently that he was asking some personnel about why Christian Wood was no longer in the NBA.Because he looks at the numbers that Christian Wood has put up and sees like a guy that could potentially, you know, in Dallas he was like nearly a double-double guy. He will give you numbers. But the reality is as you and I both know, Christian Wood is just proven to be not a winning player. That is the kind of stuff where you need people in your front office that kind of tell you like, nah, that ain't it.”

Tom Dundon on Christian Wood, Jul 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Christian Wood
item.description:
Darvin Ham on Christian Wood potentially returning for Game 3:

“First and foremost, he has a couple more boxes to check before we consider (him returning).”

Darvin Ham on Christian Wood, Apr 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Rob Pelinka, Christian Wood
item.description:
Ham told Andscape recently.

“I was on him. And then I was just checking on [Wood], letting him know, man, ‘We here, bro and we have an opportunity to do some good s—… “But [Pelinka] responded well. And finally, we bagged [Wood] up and he has been great.”

Darvin Ham on Rob Pelinka, Christian Wood, Oct 13, 2023. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Anthony Davis on DeMarcus Cousins, Julius Randle, Christian Wood, Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
“I was confused a lot. I was sliding back into the four during some possessions [and I heard], ‘AD, run corner!’ I forgot. So, it was good. Still figuring things out. Talking with the coaches and Jaxson and C-Wood about some things that I did with DeMarcus [Cousins] and Julius [Randle] back in New Orleans. So, it’s been good.”

Anthony Davis on DeMarcus Cousins, Julius Randle, Christian Wood, Jaxson Hayes, Oct 6, 2023. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Christian Wood
item.description:
Luka Doncic on Christian Wood's 21 points (10-15 FG) and 10 rebounds tonight:

“I told him last game, we’ve got to use him more. That’s on me, and I think we used him a lot more in this game, and he shows what he can do. He was amazing today, and we’ve just got to feed him.”

Luka Doncic on Christian Wood, Nov 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @CallieCaplan.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Christian Wood
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Christian Wood's acclimation through 2 full weeks of Mavs practices:

“He’s doing great. We had a great film session today. His voice was heard, participating, so I think he’s doing an incredible job on not just the defensive end, but overall trying to fit in.”

Jason Kidd on Christian Wood, Oct 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @CallieCaplan.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Christian Wood, Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
Cuban:

“I think Christian (Wood) and Frank (Ntilikina) both. In particular, what Frank did defensively (in the postseason) while being sick and banged up was insane.”

Mark Cuban on Christian Wood, Frank Ntilikina, Aug 20, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Christian Wood
item.description:
Kelly Iko:Stephen Silas:

“I don’t think there’s anyone that believes in Christian Wood more than I do.”

Stephen Silas on Christian Wood, Nov 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @KellyIkoNBA.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Christian Wood, Kevin Porter
item.description:
Stephen Silas:

“I've spent a lot of time with all the guys this summer. Jae'Sean has been in most of the summer, Kevin Porter Jr has been in most of the summer. Christian Wood is in Miami, I went to visit him in Miami.”

Stephen Silas on Christian Wood, Kevin Porter, Jul 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @AdamSpolane.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Christian Wood
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Christian Wood:

“He's a go-to guy ... I'm proud of him and the time we put in with him.”

Dwane Casey on Christian Wood, Jan 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Christian Wood
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Christian Wood:

“We tried to get him (to stay) here; we just didn't have enough in the bucket (salary cap).”

Dwane Casey on Christian Wood, Jan 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Christian Wood
item.description:
Salman Ali:DeMarcus Cousins on Christian Wood:

“I'm not surprised. We spoke on it earlier before the season got started. He's just putting everything on display now... Super talented kid. Full of potential. I'm excited to help groom him.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Christian Wood, Dec 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Stephen Silas on DeMarcus Cousins, Christian Wood
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Stephen Silas on Cousins and Wood as floor spacers:

“You can't play back on those guys as a defensive Center. You have to play up on those guys. That gives us wider lanes, more ability to get to our drive-and-kick game, and more ability to cut into the paint.”

Stephen Silas on DeMarcus Cousins, Christian Wood, Dec 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Christian Wood
item.description:
Salman Ali:DeMarcus Cousins on Christian Wood:

“He's just a guy that's full of potential. I don't even think C. Wood's knows how good he can be.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Christian Wood, Dec 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Christian Wood
item.description:
Salman Ali:DeMarcus Cousins on coming off the bench:

“I'm totally fine with it. I'm here to help C. Wood get better every single day. He's been a sponge ever since he stepped in the building. You can't ask for anything more coming from a young player.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Christian Wood, Dec 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Jordan McRae on Christian Wood
item.description:
“Me and Christian [Wood] actually went out to eat that night and he was fine, he was good,”

Jordan McRae on Christian Wood, Mar 30, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Christian Wood
item.description:
Casey said of a report in The Athletic.

“Christian was upset his name got out there. He didn’t release it. And the worst part was it got out before Christian even had a chance to tell his mom.“I was very unhappy about that. I told our staff, ‘This is unprofessional. This can’t happen again.’ It was so unfair to our player.”

Dwane Casey on Christian Wood, Mar 29, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Christian Wood
item.description:
Vincent Ellis:Blake Griffin on Christian Wood:

“Our thing with him is just staying on him about learning the game, his approach.”

Blake Griffin on Christian Wood, Dec 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @Vincent_Ellis56.
